item.title: Pimpinela Unveils Leyendas U.S. Tour Dates: ‘It’s An Expression of Gratitude’
item.description:
[Upbeat music fades out, and the host introduces the topic]
Host: "Welcome back to Trending on Billboard! We've got some exciting news for you today. Get ready to mark your calendars, because the legendary Argentine duo Pimpinela is hitting the road with their 2026 Leyendas U.S. Tour!
[Short music transition]
Host: "This intimate five-date trek, presented by Arpi Live, kicks off on November 13th at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles and wraps up on November 22nd at Miami's James L. Knight Center. Along the way, they'll be stopping in Chicago, Boston, and New York.
[Clip of Pimpinela's music plays briefly]
Host: "As Joaquín Galán, one half of the duo, said, 'This show is not only a tribute to our songs but also an expression of gratitude to the audience that has stood by us all these years.' And with 45 years of making music together, Pimpinela has become one of the bestselling Latin music artists, known for their timeless hits like 'Olvídame y Pega la Vuelta' and 'Por Ese Hombre'.
[Short music transition]
Host: "The Leyendas Tour promises to be a visually stunning experience, with live musicians, choirs, dancers, and original audiovisual content. And, they'll be joined by special guests like Dyango! Tickets go on presale on August 4th and to the general public on August 6th. Stay tuned for the ticket link, which will be revealed soon on Pimpinela's social pages.
[Closing music starts playing]
Host: "That's all for today, folks! Don't miss out on Pimpinela's 2026 Leyendas U.S. Tour. We'll see you on the road!"
